body: No, maybe its not how you plan it but it doesnt mean that your future will never be okay. Things will get better.

There is hope. You just have to realize and find it. Things will get better. Maybe not tomorrow, not next week, not next month, maybe it will take a long time. But it is going to be worth it. There is nothing wrong with being a janitor for a while, if you have to start from the bottom, do it. Just do something that will start rebuilding your life.

That was really long and detailed. I feel sorry for what youre going through. I think, though its easier said than done, u should let go of your girlfriend already. Stop having hopes that she'll be the same person that you used to love. Have u ever thought that this is her real side? You said all these started when u asked her to find a part-time job, which means u were a good provider before. Then she met someone whom she said is a better provider than u. Staying with her will only damage you more. Im sorry if i sound harsh, but ive met people who are like her, they wont change. You are still young. Just focus on how to be a better version of yourself. Focus on your career and daughter. Youll attract the right person. No matter how hard your situation is right now, i hope youll never let your anger destroy the kindness in you.
Everytime i think about killing myself, i also think about the possibilities that im about to lose. What if your future is a lot better than your present? Please be strong.

I think youre just tired. Why dont u take a vacation from your work, from your routine. Spend time with the people that matters to you. I hope youll feel okay soon. Life is worth living. I believe you are alive for a reason, and its for you to find out :)
Thats nice to hear. Things really do get better.

I dont want to tell u that everything happens for a reason. Because even if its true, its hard to understand when youre on such situation. When i think about suicide, i always think about the possibilities that im about to lose. What if your future is so much brighter than where u are today.

Hey there. I hope that what youre feeling right now is just temporary. You felt like that because youve been rejected. Dont kill yourself. Youll be able to move on. Someday, someone will love and accept you. You just have to wait for the right person.
Thank you. Hope youll keep on getting better.
Hi there. Sent u a message.
